label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts
The password reset email contains a link built from the BASE_URL constant, which defaults to "http://localhost:3000" if the PUBLIC_URL environment variable is not set. This causes reset links to point to localhost incorrectly in deployed environments. The issue is caused by the fallback to localhost in src/notifications/templates.ts, so the fix involves ensuring PUBLIC_URL is correctly set or changing the fallback logic there.

text:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts
The password reset email uses a BASE_URL constant derived from process.env.PUBLIC_URL, which falls back to "http://localhost:3000" if not set. This causes the link in the email to point to localhost instead of the correct production URL. The bug is in src/notifications/templates.ts where the reset-password link is composed.
